o.text: Ultimately from Ancient Greek ἄσφαλτος (ásphaltos, “asphalt, bitumen”).

From yön + -lü.
Cognates
* Bashkir юнле (yonli, “sensible; decent; worthy, suitable”)
* Karakalpak jónli (“worthwhile, decent; right, fair”)
* Tatar юньле (yünle, “decent, honest; smart, intelligent; good, worthy, suitable”)
* Turkish yönlü (“suitable, good, correct, appropriate”) (dialectal, Burdur, Sivas, Niğde, Konya, Antalya)
From Russian телеканал (telekanal). By surface analysis, tele- (“tele-”) + kanal (“channel”).
